I have written TeX in 1 public repository, from 2025 to 2025; in 1 of them it is the main language.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [corvidae](@/work/corvidae.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses TeX: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links TeX to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
